name: Is it better to choose a higher or lower floor for a pre-construction view?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to choose a higher or lower floor for a pre-construction view?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between a higher or lower floor for a pre-construction view involves a practical tradeoff. Higher floors often offer more expansive, unobstructed views and can command a higher price. Lower floors might provide closer views of amenities, street life, or green spaces at a potentially lower cost. The 'better' choice depends on your personal preferences for views, privacy, noise levels, and budget. For example, a direct ocean view from a higher floor in Miami Beach often differs significantly from a lower floor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Higher floors offer expansive views and higher prices; lower floors may be closer to amenities and cost less, depending on personal preference and budget.
